cli.help:
Plumivox {version}

Usage: plumivox [option]
  (no option)          From the Setup installation started in a terminal, show the getting-started guide; otherwise run the stdio MCP server
  --stdio              Run the stdio MCP server (used by Claude Code and Codex)
  --setup [options]    Set up an X account and the managed proxy interactively
  --version            Show the version
  --update-apply       Apply a downloaded update when no other Plumivox process is running (run at logon)
  --uninstall-setup    Remove the Setup installation's registrations before deleting the app (add --apply to make the change)
  --help               Show this help

Setup options:
  --prepare-key                  Create the dedicated SSH key and show its public key
  --check                        Check the saved settings and SSH key locally (no network access)
  --settings-path <path>         Settings file to use
  --private-key-path <path>      SSH private key to use
  --account <name>               Account setting name to add (default: main)
  --default-account <name>       Default account to record when adding
  --set-default-account <name>   Change only the default account

Secret values are entered at the prompts, never as command arguments.
setup.check.account_default_invalid: The default account setting is invalid. Set default_account to a registered account setting name.
setup.check.account_invalid: Set an API key and a valid user name.
setup.check.account_required: Specify an account, or set a default account with setup.
setup.check.account_unknown: The specified account setting does not exist.
setup.check.config_unavailable: The account settings could not be read. Check the settings file.
setup.check.login_credentials_invalid: Set totp_secret to the Base32 2FA secret, not to an authentication code.
setup.check.login_unavailable: Logging in needs an API key, a user name, a proxy, an email address and a password.
setup.check.proxy_config: The proxy settings are invalid. Check proxy_mode, proxy and plumivox.managed_proxy.
setup.check_ok: Checked the settings format, the dedicated SSH key, the owner and the permissions. No network access was made.
setup.error.acl_unsafe: The location must be owned by you and have permissions that other users cannot access.
setup.error.default_account_invalid: Specify a registered account setting name as the default account.
setup.error.generic: Setup could not be completed. Check the input format, the SSH key, the settings and the permissions of the location. Secret values are not shown.
setup.error.key_exists: The dedicated SSH key already exists. It is not overwritten.
setup.error.key_generation_incomplete: Key generation failed and left files behind. Check the specified private key and its .pub file, move aside only the files you have confirmed are unused or incomplete from this run, then run again. Nothing is deleted or overwritten automatically.
setup.error.mode_invalid: Check the setup options and how they are combined.
setup.error.path_invalid: Specify an absolute path without links, outside the plugin and user settings folders such as those of Codex and Claude.
setup.error.settings_changed: The settings changed while you were entering values. Check the settings and run again.
setup.error.settings_exists: An account with the same name or a shared proxy setting already exists. Existing settings are not overwritten.
setup.error.settings_save_uncertain: Saving the settings could not be confirmed. Check the .plumivox-*.tmp files in the same folder as the settings file, move aside only this run's unused files that you have confirmed yourself, then run again.
setup.error.settings_temp_retained: This run's temporary settings file could not be removed. Check the .plumivox-*.tmp files in the same folder as the settings file, move aside only this run's unused files that you have confirmed yourself, then run again.
setup.error.setup_busy: Setup for the same location is already running. Run again after it finishes.
setup.error.ssh_keygen_required: Prepare a dedicated SSH key without a passphrase with ssh-keygen.
setup.fingerprint_hint: On the VPS console, run ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub -E sha256 and compare the fingerprint.
setup.prompt.default_account: Account setting name to use as the default
setup.prompt.fingerprint: SHA256 fingerprint confirmed on the console
setup.public_key:
Public key to register on the VPS:
{key}
setup.saved: Settings saved. Secret values are not shown.
uninstall.help: Removes the Claude Code and Codex MCP registrations and the logon update entry that point at this executable of the Setup (Velopack) installation. Without --apply, only the plan is shown.
uninstall.next_planned: Run this again with --apply, then remove the app (on Windows, uninstall it from the app list in Settings; on macOS, move the .app to the Trash).
uninstall.next_removed: Now remove the app (on Windows, uninstall it from the app list in Settings; on macOS, move the .app to the Trash). The data folder with your settings and sessions is kept.
uninstall.unmanaged: This executable is not a Setup (Velopack) installation.
welcome.configured: Your X account is already set up. You can use it in new Claude Code and Codex sessions.
welcome.installed: Plumivox is installed. It was registered as an MCP server with Claude Code and Codex automatically (for each CLI that was found).
welcome.legacy_plugin: Warning: the old Plumivox plugin is still enabled in {tools}. Plumivox can then be started by both the plugin and this Setup registration. Disable the plugin's MCP or remove the plugin (see the README).
welcome.setup_next: Next, run "{executable}" --setup in a terminal to set up your X account (see "Initial setup" in the README).
welcome.updates: Updates are downloaded automatically and applied when you sign in to your computer. To turn this off, set auto_update to false in {settings}.
